requirements.gate: repository discovery returns exact HEAD, branch and dirty candidate sets
repository paths outside explicit permission fail closed
UTF-8 file reads preserve exact bytes and SHA-256
binary/non-UTF8 reads never synthesize text
diff receipts preserve staged, unstaged and untracked candidates
invalid refs and oversized diffs fail closed
patch proposal records Git-parsed target set, source candidates and preimages
traversal, .git targets, ambiguous path encoding and oversized patches fail closed

coding container uses immutable pinned image, read-only host source mount, ephemeral writable tmpfs workspace, read-only rootfs, dropped capabilities, no-new-privileges, non-root UID/GID, no IPC and network none
network-enabled coding plans, writable host-source mounts, implicit image pulls and unpinned images fail closed
approval-gated patch mutation revalidates HEAD, patch hash, candidate set and preimages before mutation and conserves HEAD
HEAD drift, patch drift, preimage drift, dirty overlap and unexpected new dirty paths block or roll back mutation
test/lint/type/build/security/benchmark checks produce terminal PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED execution receipts only through the isolated coding-container boundary
required nonzero checks prevent PASS; required container/image/isolation failures remain BLOCKED rather than being mislabeled as test failures
review findings bind to changed file, source SHA-256 and exact line evidence
review findings against unchanged paths or invalid line ranges are rejected
work-branch creation binds exact clean HEAD; commits require a non-protected branch, exact approved dirty set, no pre-existing staged state, exact parent and exact committed path set
protected branch mutation, stale HEAD, dirty-set drift, pre-staged state and failed commit postconditions block or roll back
PR request artifact binds exact clean head branch, base branch, title/body and request SHA-256 without performing an unauthenticated network action
live pinned coding image and container-engine execution must be demonstrated before CODE-06/CODE-07 PASS
remote branch push and PR submission require an explicitly authenticated final-stage adapter with preserved request identity
hosted CI must admit executable jobs or independent trusted execution evidence must be frozen
zero unresolved residue inside the declared coding scope before CODING CERTIFIED

certification_rule: Merged source, valid plans, unit fixtures, or startup-failed CI are insufficient for certification; PASS requires applicable executable evidence, frozen runtime/image identity, closed arithmetic, and zero unresolved residue inside scope.
